mentions.name: Backdrop
mentions.description: A cross-platform desktop app for taking and beautifying screenshots. It captures screenshots and lets users add padding, shadows, rounded corners, backgrounds, watermarks, and aspect ratios suited to target social media platforms. Built with Clojure, it is planned to run on Linux, Windows, and macOS at launch.
mentions.problem: The author couldn't find a neat screenshot app on Linux for taking and sharing screenshots.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently, I've been working on Backdrop [1], a desktop app for taking and beautifying screenshots.
